Silvio is another horror adventure. It's entire premises is built around Electric Voice Phenomena (aka EVP), that is, the voices of the dead recorded with audio equipment. While you occasionally fight ghosts, you spend more time recording them and decrypting their voices with a tape recorder. As with Scratches, the gameplay isn't really that good (especially the utterly pointless driving elements), but the constant backdrop of static you hear while searching for acoustic anomalies does make your hair stand up.

**The Vanishing of Ethan Carter **essentially is a walking simulator that actually is good - the entire game essentially is one big mindfuck as you never are quite sure what the hell actually is going on.

The Void (also known as Turgor in Russian) is an adventure/ressource management game set in a fairly disturbing form of afterlife. Made by Ice Pick Lodge. Same studio also did Pathologic, which isn't everyone's coup of tea but may be to your liking.
